The original text says lack of exophthalmos and absence of thyroid enlargement make Graves less convincing, though not impossible; the statements capture the individual facts but not the 'though not impossible' nuance.

The original text states that the PET-CT shows disseminated malignancy with dominant liver masses and gastric antral uptake, suggesting metastatic gastric neuroendocrine tumor; the statements split this into separate pieces and do not fully preserve the inferential link from PET-CT findings to the suggested diagnosis.
